overview_description.description:
ZepzPay is an online service that allows users to send money internationally. The online service that lets people send money to friends and family living abroad, using a computer, smartphone, or tablet. It is a convenient, low-cost alternative to traditional money transfer companies that use high street agents and charge high fees. Money can be received as a bank deposit, cash pick-up, Mobile Money, or mobile airtime top-up.  The platform supports customers in 50 markets and connects them to recipients worldwide, including through popular brands like WorldRemit and Sendwave.

Zepz's service is available to senders in 50 countries. They offer transfers to more than 140+ destinations across Europe, Asia, Africa, Australia, and the Americas.
